purpose: Independent implementation comparison for matched ideal models; Orekit is not exact truth or real-world validation.

matching.inertial_frame: GCRF, same Cartesian components interpreted in both implementations.
matching.time_definition: Elapsed SI seconds from the common TAI epoch.
matching.coefficient_convention: Fully normalized Pbar20=sqrt(5)*P2; Cbar20=-J2/sqrt(5). Degree 2/order 0 only; all other non-central coefficients zero.
matching.central_gravity: One explicit NewtonianAttraction; automatic addition disabled. Holmes-Featherstone is non-central only.
matching.orekit_body_shape: OneAxisEllipsoid with flattening exactly zero (sphere). No ellipsoidal substitution.
matching.atmosphere_frame: Uniform passive rotation about GCRF +z; axes coincide at epoch. No ITRF, EOP, precession/nutation or winds.
matching.termination: Stop on descending spherical-altitude crossing at 200000 m; reject initial state at/below limit. Compare only common available times.
matching.data_files: None needed: built-in GCRF/TAI, explicitly supplied constants, ideal rotation and toy atmosphere.
matching.integrators: SciPy DOP853 and Hipparchus DormandPrince853Integrator; independent implementations of the same RK family.

agreement_gate.meaning: Consistency gate before subsequent cases; not a real-world accuracy bound.

central.difference_convention: Orekit minus SciPy for cross-library pairs; RTN frame follows the stated SciPy level.
